settingsDescription: The key is used by the speech editor. Sign in to your account separately.
configured: API key saved in the IDE profile
embed: The mini cabinet embeds in desktop DevLine. Browser mode uses the external account page.
invalid: Invalid .tfspeech document. Open the source and check the JSON fields.
TELLFAIR_KEY: API key is invalid or revoked.
TELLFAIR_BALANCE: Check your character balance and API access in your plan.
TELLFAIR_RATE: Request limit reached. Try again later.
TELLFAIR_SERVER: Tellfair could not generate speech. Try again later.
TELLFAIR_AUDIO: Tellfair returned an unsupported or oversized audio file.
keyHelp: The key is stored in this IDE profile, outside your project. API access is managed in your Tellfair account.
keyInvalid: Use a Tellfair key beginning with tf_live_.
keySaveFailed: Could not save the key. Try again.
accountHint: Balance and custom voices are available through the API. Add your private link in Tellfair settings to embed the mini cabinet.
catalogFailed: Voices could not be loaded. Your saved IDs still work; use Reload to try again.
customVoiceHelp: Copy the ID of your cloned voice from Tellfair. A custom voice overrides the built-in voice.
resetParams: Reset parameters and seed to preset defaults
seedRange: Use a whole number from -2147483648 to 2147483647.
speedHelp: Speech speed, 0.5 to 2. Empty uses the preset.
exaggerationHelp: Expression strength, 0.25 to 2. Empty uses the preset.
cfg_weightHelp: Voice adherence, 0 to 1. Empty uses the preset.
temperatureHelp: Variation, 0.05 to 1.5. Empty uses the preset.
seedHelp: The same seed makes repeated generation more consistent. Leave empty for a random seed.
fixFields: Fix the highlighted parameters before saving or generating.
textLimit: One request supports up to 5000 characters. Shorten the text or split it into files.
textPlaceholder: Write a line, narration or dialogue…
staleAudio: Text or voice settings changed. This audio belongs to the earlier version.
jobConnectionLost: Could not read the result. Check again without starting another paid generation.
audioError: Could not play this audio. Save it to the project to open it in another player.
piperHint: Piper supports Russian. Emotion parameters do not apply.
miniHelp: Tellfair → Account → below API keys → Mini cabinet → Copy. This link grants speech access and stays in your local DevLine profile. Refresh the right Tellfair panel after saving.
miniSaveFailed: Could not save this link. Use an HTTPS mini cabinet URL on tellfair.com.
TELLFAIR_PLAN: This operation requires another Tellfair plan.
TELLFAIR_NOT_FOUND: Tellfair job, voice or file was not found.
